name: dogfood-sveltekit-http3-multiplex-app
description: Dogfood app v1.28-4 — a SvelteKit + nginx-quic HTTP/3 + QUIC stream multiplex + priority scheduling + HPACK dynamic table + 0-RTT resumption experience that exercises the QUIC multiplex axes across a provider-neutral Http3MultiplexAdapter, drivable in both KIWA_MODE=real (calls nginx-quic testcontainers when HTTP3_KEY=1) and KIWA_MODE=mock (@kiwa-lab/realtime v0.2 createQuicMultiplexMock + createHttp3PushMock) so behavioural fidelity feeds @kiwa-lab/quality-metrics 12-axis release gate.

scripts.test: pnpm -F @kiwa-lab/realtime -F @kiwa-lab/core -F @kiwa-lab/quality-metrics build && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node --hookTimeout 30000
